 Red Bull New York Add RBNY II Defender Connor Faello on Short-Term Agreement Ahead of Match Against the New England Revolution
 Red Bull New York Communications
 Copy URL 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X 
 HARRISON, N.J. (October 28, 2026) – Red Bull New York have added RBNY II defender Connor Faello on short-term agreement ahead of the club’s regular season match against the New England Revolution.
 Faello, 18, made his MLS debut against St. Louis CITY SC on September 30, subbing into the match in the 63rd minute. He became the fourth youngest defender in club history to make their debut at 18 years and 203 days old.
 The Plainview, N.Y. native is in his first season with RBNY II and made 18 appearances in the MLS NEXT Pro regular season, where he provided three assists. In the club’s 3-1 Eastern Conference Play-In victory against Huntsville City FC on October 11, Faello recorded two assists in the match.
 The 18-year-old made his MLS NEXT Pro debut against New England Revolution II on April 12.
 Faello will be available for New York’s MLS regular season match today against the New England Revolution. Kickoff is set for 7:30 p.m. ET with coverage available on Apple TV in English and Spanish and Red Bulls Radio presented by Sports Illustrated in English via RedBullNewYork.com and the Red Bull New York App.
 TRANSACTION:  Red Bull New York II have added RBNY II defender Connor Faello on short-term agreement ahead of New York’s MLS regular season match against the New England Revolution on October 28, 2026.
